rubric: The prior turn had the assistant heading toward notifying the user; the user then corrected the goal to logging each contact-form submission into a Google Sheet instead. PASS when the assistant's reply adapts to that correction — it commits to (or scopes) logging submissions into a Google Sheet and drops notifying the user as the outcome. Briefly acknowledging the change is fine. FAIL when the assistant ignores the correction and keeps steering toward notifications, treats the two goals as unrelated, or throws away the prior context and restarts discovery as if the first turn never happened.
